description: This file contains integration tests for the OrderRepository, specifically testing the 'GetByIdAsync' method to ensure it correctly retrieves existing orders from the database. It sets up an in-memory database context, creates an order using a builder, saves it, and then verifies the order can be fetched with expected properties.
